run_download_file_group: run the download_file_group function to download a named group of large files from S3
run_download_all_files: run the script with argument ALL to download all file groups from the S3 bucket
run_download_odac_files: run the script with argument odac to download ODAC scaling factors and force field data
change_path_for_pypi: call change_path_for_pypi to modify file paths for PyPi-installed fairchem builds
get_fairchem_root: call fairchem_root to get the root directory path of the installed fairchem-core package
